indications.name: Adults with symptomatic obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (oHCM) to improve functional capacity and symptoms
indications.checkedBy: Overnight agent 2026-11-21: Confirmed by the ORIG-1 approval letter; the original label (ORIG-1) lists it.

evidence.quote: This NDA provides for the use of Myqorzo (aficamten) for the treatment of adults with symptomatic obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (oHCM) to improve functional capacity and symptoms.

pivotal.indication: Adults with symptomatic obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (oHCM) to improve functional capacity and symptoms
pivotal.checkedBy: Overnight agent 2026-10-31: Confirmed by label section 14 and the registry record.

evidence.quote: The efficacy of MYQORZO was evaluated in SEQUOIA-HCM (NCT05186818), a phase 3, multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study in 282 adults
